Content: MemorySmith chat is provider-based. IChatProvider isolates model API calls/model discovery/streaming and IChatAgent isolates memory/page context gathering and agent-write behavior. OllamaChatProvider uses /api/chat with stream=true for live chunks and /api/tags for model discovery on the configured Ollama endpoint. GitHubCopilotChatProvider uses GitHub.Copilot.SDK with GitHub CLI auth or token env vars and exposes configured fallback models when SDK discovery is unavailable; the default order prefers free or low-cost GPT candidates first, then Claude Haiku, then Claude Sonnet. GitHub model-unavailable and authentication failures are rewritten in the /chat UI with actionable guidance for refreshing discovered models or configuring GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, COPILOT_API_KEY, GitHubCliPath, or GitHubCliUrl. MemoryChatAgent uses conservative, intent-aware preloading: exact-reply/simple prompts and write-only Agent commands skip local wiki pre-context, explicit MemorySmith/wiki/codebase prompts get a small bounded hybrid/page preload via Chat:MaxPreloadedContextRecords and Chat:MaxPreloadedContextPages, and each item is still capped by Chat:MaxContextItemCharacters. Memory hits are hydrated from full MemoryRecord content instead of only the leading search snippet when they are preloaded. ChatToolCatalog defines shared read-only wiki tool behavior used by both chat interception and MCP endpoints for page search/get and unified search in addition to memory search tools. When preloaded context is absent or insufficient, the prompt tells the model to return exactly one app-intercepted MCP-compatible toolCalls JSON object with no prose/fence/explanation; MemoryChatAgent recognizes toolCalls or JSON-RPC tools/call payloads, runs read-only local wiki tools, adds Local MemorySmith tool results to the same provider turn, tracks those accessed resources as ChatContextOrigins.Tool, and asks for the final answer without exposing tool JSON to the user. Supported chat-side tools are memorysmith_unified_search, memorysmith_search, memorysmith_semantic_search, memorysmith_hybrid_search, memorysmith_context_pack, memorysmith_get, memorysmith_page_search, and memorysmith_page_get. The prompt recommends unified search for broad memory/page discovery, hybrid or semantic search for memory retrieval, context packs for reference/backlink depth, and exact get/page-get calls when an ID or slug is known; fallback runtime prompt code also injects this tool guidance and Markdown/Mermaid output hints for custom prompts that omit them. ChatIntentInterceptor can also pre-run clear wiki intents (such as unified search, context pack retrieval, or page fetch) before provider generation, and those intercepted resources are also shown as tool-accessed resources. Each provider turn also includes a runtime capability message derived from the request mode, read-only tool setting, AgentWritesEnabled, and the current user's authenticated roles, so the model is explicitly told whether it can only read, whether Agent writes are disabled, and whether the current user may approve writes. Stream updates include structured trace events with tool metadata, duration, and token estimates. The shared chat prompt asks for GitHub-flavored Markdown in normal Chat mode answers, while Agent mode still returns strict JSON around any Markdown values. ChatMarkdownRenderer uses Markdig advanced extensions plus MemorySmith Mermaid/Prism renderers: complete mermaid fenced code emits pre.mermaid for client-side Mermaid rendering, unclosed mermaid fences stay Prism-compatible language-mermaid code while text streams, other fenced code emits Prism-compatible language-* code classes, raw HTML is disabled for chat, and unsafe link schemes are neutralized before transcript rendering. The Athena Ollama modelfile carries the same wiki-tool and Markdown/Mermaid instruction. The chat UI renders History and Trace as tabs in one shared right sidebar, keeps the toolbar/composer compact while switching between those tabs, places the sidebar toggle on the right edge next to the sidebar, offers a persisted Auto/Light/Dark Diagram theme selector for Mermaid, wraps rendered diagrams in matching readable light/dark surfaces, and skips Mermaid conversion while a response is actively streaming so incomplete diagrams do not flash error overlays. Trace has a compact execution graph, turn selector, filters, collapsible trace headers, interleaved reasoning segments, preloaded context summaries, tool call requests, tool results, and assistant output so users can inspect turn internals without reading raw JSON blobs. The transcript no longer renders per-turn Trace buttons, and selecting a history chat synchronizes the Trace tab to that chat's most recent inspectable turn. Tool-call trace entries keep editable JSON arguments and can be rerun from the panel; rerun results append to the same turn and add touched resources as tool context. ChatRunControl supports an icon Finish Step soft stop that lets the current provider/tool step finish before stopping the loop, while the icon Stop control remains immediate cancellation. Chat:ToolCallsEnabled, Chat:MaxToolIterations, Chat:MaxToolCallsPerTurn, and Chat:MaxToolResultCharacters bound the loop. Agent mode can parse structured provider output and propose MemoryRecord entries and Data/Pages markdown pages when Chat:AgentWritesEnabled is true; the /chat UI requests approval mode, stores proposed writes on the turn, and requires an authenticated Editor or Admin plus explicit approve/reject actions in the Trace tab before applying writes through IChatAgent.ApplyAgentWritesAsync. Approval-required replies replace provider claims with neutral pending-proposal text, so the UI/model does not tell users a page or memory was created before written IDs exist. Tool calls remain read-only. Image attachments are saved to trusted temp files and passed as native image payloads to providers that support images. Usage metadata flows through ChatUsageSummary: Ollama final chunks can report prompt/eval token counts, GitHub SDK usage/context events can report context-window and quota snapshots, and MemoryChatAgent estimates token usage when providers do not report it. The /chat UI supports provider/model selection, persisted provider/model/mode/diagram theme and active chat, streamed response text with elapsed timers and per-response durations, assistant turn model metadata such as Ollama / Athena or GitHub / gpt-4.1, a bottom-right context usage meter with optional provider rate/quota text, icon Stop and Finish Step controls with tooltips, Send on Enter, file and clipboard image attachments with explicit X remove buttons, retained per-chat drafts/queued attachments, delete-chat confirmation, compact chat history titles, thinking content anchored above the visible answer with active animation, local chat history, and clickable memory/page resource chips inside a collapsed per-turn References drawer. Markdown display surfaces use extra padding in memory, page, chat, code, table, Mermaid, and Mermaid-error boxes. Default preloaded context chips retain the neutral wiki-chip styling, mid-chat/intercepted tool resources use a blue chip theme, and created pages remain green write chips. The design leaves room for OpenAI, Anthropic, or other providers without changing the UI or agent workflow.
Title: Chat Agent Provider Architecture
